title: Hi! I'm Emily
content-en: I’m a UI/UX Designer committed to communicating with team members to solve problems and handling design projects with excellent collaborative efforts. In addition to UI/UX, I have been exposed to different fields such as front-end development, industrial design, 3D printing etc. I looking forward to providing every user with better experiences and look to learn new things everyday.
content-ch: 擁有 6+ 年專案實戰經驗。致力於透過 Design System 系統化設計思維和深入的 UX Research 使用者研究，將優異的使用者體驗轉化為產品的實質業務增長，並持續優化用戶留存與轉換率。這裡整理了我的工作經歷、代表作品與聯絡方式，歡迎逛逛。
